thread:
Sasha K.: Heads-up — Brighton sent back a combined SOC2 + DPA questionnaire and flagged embeddings retention as a renewal risk. They want answers by EOD Friday. Anyone available to triage? :eyes:
Jamal R.: I can take SOC2 controls mapping. Quick Q: do they use Dedicated or Hosted? That affects data residency answers.
Riley CS: Hosted, but they asked about optional BYOK for embeddings — might push to Dedicated if BYOK required.
Oliver (onboarding): Uploading the doc to the onboarding folder now. Link: https://files.redwood/brighton/q1-soc2-dpa.pdf
eng-bot: New ticket created: CS-1379 — "Brighton: SOC2+DPA follow-up" assigned to Jamal R., due 2024-05-17.
Maya - Legal: I'll review the DPA clauses for subprocessors and retention. If they require a retention addendum for embeddings, we need to confirm where embeddings are stored (hot vs cold).
Jamal R.: Noted. For SOC2 section: I'll need the last audit snapshot and the control owner for key rotation. Can someone ping infra?
Oliver (onboarding): @eng-infra, can you confirm key rotation cadence for Hosted? We document 90-day rotation in the onboarding playbook but need a proof snippet.
Sasha K.: Also Brighton flagged: "Are embeddings deleted on account termination?" — wants a clear operational flow. Suggest we provide a one-page data lifecycle summary.
Riley CS: I'll draft the data lifecycle page and include the termination/retention steps. Will need confirmation from infra on retention deletion SLA (e.g., 30 days).
Jamal R.: I pulled the audit artefacts, attaching excerpt: ```
- SOC2 Type II period: 2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30
- Key rotation: 90 days (KMS-managed)
- Incident response: 24h initial contact
```
Maya - Legal: For embeddings BYOK: if they insist, we should clarify scope — BYOK for model weights vs BYOK for key wrapping on embeddings storage. There's different risk/commitment.
Oliver (onboarding): Brighton also wants to know if we support pseudonymization for PII before embedding. Roadmap says no native transform yet, but customers can preprocess before sending.
Riley CS: I'll add that note and offer a short-runbook on how to pseudonymize before upload.
Jamal R.: Question for eng: is there an existing API flag to mark embedding data for shorter TTL? @eng-infra?
eng-bot: Channel message: infra-deploy-387 completed. No direct API for TTL per object; retention is tenant-level config.
Sasha K.: Ok, call to action: Jamal — SOC2 control answers + audit excerpts by tomorrow noon. Maya — DPA review + redlines by tomorrow EOD. Riley/Oliver — data lifecycle doc + pseudonymization runbook draft by tomorrow. If any blockers escalate here.
Riley CS: Aiming for drafts by 11:00 tomorrow. I'll add a small FAQ for renewal impact: if BYOK required we note potential migration window and cost delta.
Maya - Legal: Also flagging insurance ask — Brighton included a question about breach notification SLA tied to their contract. We should confirm legal-approved SLA language.
Jamal R.: Will include the backup/restore and deletion proof steps. If we need longer provenance logs, that might be an add-on.
Oliver (onboarding): I'm updating the onboarding checklist: "send data lifecycle + retention SLA + SOC2 excerpt" as required deliverables for this account.
Sasha K.: Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a short note here and I'll coordinate with the AE to push the deadline. :thumbsup:
Riley CS: Quick FYI — Brighton rep said they'd prefer a single packet (one PDF) rather than multiple docs. I'll combine once drafts are ready.
eng-bot: Brighton support ticket linked: https://support.redwood/tickets/BR-9201
Sasha K.: Great. Closing loop: we'll review the combined packet tomorrow 3pm PT before sending. Invite: calendar event sent.
Riley CS: Copy — see you at 3pm.
Maya - Legal: prepping redlines, will bring any legal risks to the 3pm review.
Jamal R.: Draft SOC2 answers uploaded to CS-1379 comments. Please review.
Oliver (onboarding): Uploaded the data lifecycle draft to the ticket.
Sasha K.: Awesome — thanks all. If Brighton pushes earlier, we may need to re-run the 1hr review.
Riley CS: noted. :rocket:
